verdict.rationale: Stripe publishes an official GitHub repository of OpenAPI specifications for its API (docs-41), and Terminal offers an API-based integration on that same Stripe API (docs-1), so a downloadable machine-readable spec exists. The probe found no spec at conventional docs.stripe.com paths (probe-3), but that only shows where the spec isn't hosted and does not contradict the GitHub-hosted repo. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that Terminal resources are covered in the spec, discoverability at a standard well-known/docs path, and independent hands-on corroboration of downloading and using the spec.
